inputs.text: A young Asian woman with long black hair stands in a sun-dappled forest; her hair flows freely over her shoulders, styled into a loose braided ponytail secured with a purple ribbon. She has fair skin and a gentle smile, with her expression soft and inviting. She wears a white off-the-shoulder top with delicate lace trim along the neckline and cuffs, featuring a bow at the center and a tight flare at the bottom that reveals a purple belt; a thin gold chain hangs around her neck, adorned with an oval-shaped purple gemstone pendant. In her right hand, she gently holds a purple wind lily vine with petals unfurling and slender stems bearing green leaves. Soft golden sunlight filters through the leaves on the left, casting a dreamy, warm, and natural atmosphere. The background is a soft, misty green shadow and a blur of scattered light, capturing the essence of a serene and magical setting.

一位黑色长发的年轻亚洲女子站在阳光斑驳的森林中，头发自然披散在肩头并编成一条松散的长辫，用紫色发圈固定。她的皮肤白皙，嘴唇微张，笑容甜美，表情温柔。她身穿一袭白色露肩上衣，领口和袖口饰有精致蕾丝花边，胸前系着蝴蝶结，下摆微微收紧露出紫色腰带；脖子上戴着一条金色细链，坠着一枚椭圆形紫色宝石吊坠。她的右手轻轻捏住一朵紫色风铃草，花瓣舒展，花茎细长带有绿色叶片。柔和的金色阳光从左侧树叶间洒落，背景是朦胧的绿色树影与散景光点，整体画面呈现温暖、自然且梦幻的氛围。
